Noida's Jewar Airport Renamed After Prime Minister Narendra Modi

Uttar Pradesh's cabinet has approved the renaming of the upcoming Jewar airport near Noida to Narendra Modi International Airport. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced the decision following a cabinet meeting, stating the airport will become the state's largest aviation hub. The airport is being developed by Yamuna International Airport Private Limited.
